references.text: The people promised to obey everything the Lord had said through Moses, just as they here promise to obey Joshua
Israel's pledge of obedience to Moses at Sinai, now transferred to Joshua
Moses assures Joshua that the Lord will be with him, just as the people here express their wish that God would be with Joshua as he was with Moses
God's promise to be with Joshua as he was with Moses, which the people refer to here
The Lord confirms that he will be with Joshua as he was with Moses, in order to exalt him in the eyes of Israel
The fulfillment of the people's wish - the Lord exalted Joshua so that the people honored him as they had honored Moses
Moses appoints Joshua as leader and transfers some of his authority to him, which forms the basis for the people's pledge of obedience
